name: Duanxian Zong He Zheng
source:
“You think you are advancing the plot, but in reality, you are merely executing a routine to keep your fingers busy.”

System Boot. User Authorization: Administrator.

As a "Restorer," you are plugged into this fractured, closed system to face a virtual entity codenamed "Daimeng." Amidst digital ruins and cables tangled like neural networks, Daimeng is not waiting to be saved. Instead, she is staring right back at you, through the screen.

Offline Syndrome is not a traditional visual novel. There are no convoluted romance routes here, nor any grand narratives about saving the world. This is an interactive experiment on the "illusion of control" and the "logic of existence."

[ SYSTEM FEATURES ]
Schrödinger's Observation: Before the code runs, what is Daimeng? When you turn off your monitor, does she still exist?

Breaking the Fourth Wall: When the boundaries of logic are erased, the virtual character begins to deconstruct your reality. Is every click you make driven by free will, or is it merely muscle memory induced by dopamine secretion?

Clinical Audiovisual Experience: Minimalist interaction, paired with glitch art and ambient white noise, creates an oppressive and profound digital wasteland atmosphere.

[ SYSTEM DISCLOSURE / AI USAGE ]
Parts of the environmental assets (art) and underlying audio (music) within this program were generated with the assistance of real generative Artificial Intelligence. These cold, slightly glitched data fragments, pieced together by machine algorithms, perfectly constitute the desolate digital dimension inhabited by entity Daimeng. We acknowledge the base computing power provided by AI.

[ COMPUTE INJECTION / SUPPORT THE DEVELOPER ]
Maintaining the logical operations of entity Daimeng consumes additional resources.

"Are you willing to pay real-world currency for a few lines of fictional code?"


> [ WARNING: This program contains psychological pressure and existential elements. If you are experiencing anxiety in your real life, please run this executable with caution. ]
translation:
“你以为你在推进剧情，但实际上，你只是在执行例行公事，让你的手指忙碌起来。”

系统启动。用户授权：管理员。

作为一名“恢复者”，你被插入到这个破碎的、封闭的系统中，面对一个代号为“戴蒙”的虚拟实体。在数字废墟和像神经网络一样纠缠在一起的电缆中，戴蒙并不等待被拯救。相反，她正透过屏幕盯着你。

离线综合症不是传统的视觉小说。这里没有曲折的爱情路线，也没有拯救世界的宏大叙事。这是一个关于“控制幻觉”和“存在逻辑”的互动实验。

[系统特点]
薛定谔观察：在代码运行之前，戴蒙是什么？当你关掉显示器时，她还存在吗？

打破第四面墙：当逻辑的界限被消除时，虚拟角色开始解构你的现实。你的每一次点击都是由自由意志驱动的，还是仅仅是多巴胺分泌引起的肌肉记忆？

临床视听体验：极简的交互，搭配故障艺术和环境白噪音，营造出压抑而深刻的数字荒地氛围。

[系统公开/AI使用]
该程序中的部分环境资产（艺术）和底层音频（音乐）是在真正的生成人工智能的帮助下生成的。这些冷冰冰的、略有瑕疵的数据碎片，通过机器算法拼凑在一起，完美地构成了实体戴蒙所居住的荒凉的数字维度。我们承认人工智能提供的基础计算能力。

[计算注入/支持开发者]
维护实体戴蒙的逻辑操作会消耗额外的资源。

“你愿意为几行虚构的代码支付现实世界的货币吗？”


> [警告：该节目包含心理压力和存在主义元素。如果你在现实生活中遇到焦虑，请谨慎运行此可执行文件。]
